This name is a beautiful reminder of one's devotion and dedication to the divine. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Tamil, Malayalam, Telugu. Parents who choose Yatheesh usually hope their child will grow to embody dedicated to god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
